newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 1.97 percent after BIAT bank shares dropped by 45 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 559.39 from 570.64 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 1.84 million dinars against 15.79 million dinars.
BIAT bank was down 25.96 dinars to 33 dinars in a settlement on the new computerised trading system after a one-month hold. "The share has now its market true value," a trader said.
Airline TUNISAIR was down 4.04 dinar to 21.8 dinars. Chemical firm AL KIMIA was down 1.4 dinar to 38.6 dinars. ATB bank was up 1.76 dinar to 58.66 dinars.
